question: Can the native Qwen3.5 tokenizer restore byte-for-byte prompt parity across the same 144 complete requests, preserve every previously valid trajectory and let the finished joint decoder beat untouched Base on the prespecified semantic and resource outcomes?
protocol: Frozen-checkpoint inference only. The first trial stopped on item 128 because Transformers selected the Qwen2 tokenizer for the looped export. No further optimization, examples, model selection or changes to weights are allowed. Use the exact finished 2200-update binary, the original 144 ordered pairs, full generation policies and every original numeric gate. Load Qwen3.5Tokenizer from the installed export on both short and parent routes. Start both arms cold and replay the full stream from its beginning, charging each response and actual callback. Require 144/144 identical opening sequences on both arms and all 120 previously stored valid candidate trajectories to reproduce token-for-token. The failed original remains sealed; report its charged time and this independent corrective measurement separately. This study can establish input parity and quantify the same model's performance. Any missed semantic or resource gate keeps the trained policy experimental.
gate: Require 14 net more completed-correct mixed outcomes than Base, exact paired and shared-resource randomization p<=.05, six net gains on the 72 new human requests and at least one gain in each of new word problems, binary passage judgments and user-authored extraction. All enrolled families must equal or beat Base on correct answers, completed correct outcomes and completion. Require 12 net more grounded actions, every previously correct task in both 50-request release and 22-call public retention panels, and strictly lower first-token sum, end-to-end sum and native peak. The same model object must serve both short modes, seven distinct native attention histories and the cached vs full last-token top decision must agree with max logit deviation <=.6. Stop at the first pair or the resource ceiling. Any missed criterion closes this fit. A pass licenses an equal-exposure one-application trained control and a new isolated 128K retention and field replication before release.
